title: A constructible subset of an affine spectrum is the image of an affine scheme
statement: Let $R$ be a commutative ring and let $E\subseteq\operatorname{Spec}R$ be a constructible subset [def-weil-constructible-subset] of the underlying topological space of the affine scheme $\operatorname{Spec}R$ [def-weil-affine-spectrum]. Then there are a commutative ring $A$ and a ring homomorphism $\varphi:R\to A$ such that the image of the morphism $\operatorname{Spec}\varphi:\operatorname{Spec}A\to\operatorname{Spec}R$ (on points $\mathfrak q\mapsto\varphi^{-1}(\mathfrak q)$) is exactly $E$ (Stacks Algebra, Lemma 00F8, which moreover gives $\varphi$ of finite presentation; that part is not stated here).
